items.text: All 8 workshop decisions from rounds 1 and 2 were incorporated into plan.md. Every decision selected the recommended option (A). All [PENDING] markers have been removed and replaced with confirmed approach descriptions referencing the specific workshop decision.

Approach solidified: CLI uses custom RoundTripper for transparent header injection (d1-r2). API uses global middleware with interface-based Verifier for testability (d2-r2, d3-r1). Backlog store enforces created_by immutability at the persistence layer (d3-r2). Activity records auto-populate from context provenance (d4-r2). Execution started_by stays as string with convention encoding (d2-r1). UI shows inline badges with icons (d4-r1). Backlog created_by uses structured JSON object (d1-r1).

Readiness upgraded to 3/3 across all dimensions. Problem clarity and scope were already at 3. Approach is now fully solid — all implementation phases have concrete file targets, confirmed strategies, and no open questions. Testability is strong with 9 specific test cases, a clean Verifier seam, and integration test coverage. Risk matrix is complete with mitigations for all identified risks.

No remaining gaps. The plan covers all 13 mandatory sections per the implementation-plan-authoring skill. Required reading is specified. All 7 expected deliverables from the spec are addressed across the 6 implementation phases. The item is ready for execution.

plan_updates: Removed all [PENDING] markers. Each phase now references the specific workshop decision that confirmed its approach. Target end state updated to reflect structured created_by object and inline badge UI. Contract decisions section annotated with workshop decision references.
